_comment: The Spore path (cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.17; cooks/build-biome-fungal.md 2.17). Resource Spores: a spender bar (100, +20 a Spore capacity rank) that refills 5 a second (x2 standing in any spore cloud) and +3 for every planted Spore you detonate. Spells and Wildbrands plant Spores on enemies (cyan nodules, 20 s, up to 10 a target, +1 a capacity rank; 5 on players); Detonate (free with Spore cloud, its own quick slot) bursts every one you've planted within 20 m. The root passive Immune system (main path only): immune to poison and rot, so spore clouds are harmless. Abilities are UWRGameplayAbility subclasses in WRAbilitiesSpore.* registered under spore in UWRAbilityRegistry::ClassForNode; the rules are WRSporePath.*; numbers in tuning spores, sporePath, spells.<key>, wildbrands.infect_strike.
name: Spore

rootPassive.name: Immune system
rootPassive.text: Immune to poison and rot. Spore clouds are harmless to you.

trunk.name: Spore cloud
trunk.text: Basic spell: plant Spores on enemies in a cloud

trunk.name: Detonate
trunk.text: Free with Spore cloud: burst every Spore you've planted within 20 m (8 and rot 10 each)

nodes.name: Pandemic
nodes.text: Capstone: rot jumps between all nearby enemies

nodes.name: Host
nodes.text: Enemies killed by Spores spawn sporelings

nodes.name: Fungal behemoth
nodes.text: Capstone: summon a giant spore creature

nodes.name: Spore armor
nodes.text: A spore coat that reduces damage

nodes.name: Toxic blood
nodes.text: Attackers get Spores planted on them

nodes.name: Living colony
nodes.text: Capstone: become a walking spore cloud that infects enemies and heals you
